title: Stocks plunge on Anthropic amid tech fears
summary: ABC News correspondent Elizabeth Schulze reports on a steep Friday sell-off that came a day after Anthropic's record stock-market debut and pushed the Nasdaq below where it started the year. Chipmakers and other AI-infrastructure names fell hardest, Nvidia was also hurt by the sudden exit of its chief executive, and Anthropic itself gave back part of its first-day gains. Behind the drop are growing doubts about whether AI valuations and spending can be justified, sharpened by election results that suggest slower data-centre construction.
focus: Shadow the opening lines where the size of the Nasdaq and S&P 500 drop is laid out, then the short explanation of why investors are questioning AI spending.
